svg.text: My film waste is 60% LDPE, 20% PET, 10% nylon 6 and 10% EVOH, at 8,000 t/year. Compare
up to three solvent washes and residual destinations for profit, emissions and circularity, using
the published default distances. Compare a dedicated plant with a shared 20,000 t/year plant,
and show cost sensitivity for LDPE in toluene.
